title: Win holiday demand by selling to AI agents and pricing for scarce memory
summary: Adobe: online holiday spend +9.1% to $82.5B; NRF: half of shoppers plan AI use. Walmart opened Black Friday to Meta’s agent; ChatGPT Wallet is live. Dell sees tight memory into 2027; PCBs short to mid-2028.

points.headline: AI agents are now a live buying channel for holiday deals
points.detail: Walmart put Black Friday deals in Meta’s Muse agent, ChatGPT Wallet lets Pro users buy via agent, and Klarna joined Adyen’s agent suite. We should make our catalog, promos and financing agent-readable.

points.headline: Memory and PCB shortages keep PC prices rising into 2027-28
points.detail: Dell expects tight memory supply in 2027, PCB relief isn’t seen before mid-2028, and European notebook revenue rose 16% on pricier models. We should plan inventory, pricing and mix for tighter supply.

points.headline: Holiday demand is strong online, but affordability shapes tech buying
points.detail: Adobe shows online holiday spend up 9.1%; Circana says tech sales may hinge on delayed back-to-school buyers; Amex sees record small-business spend. Lead with value, financing and business bundles.

points.headline: Best Buy computing holds despite higher memory-driven prices
points.detail: Gaming and AI-capable PCs are absorbing price rises at Best Buy, and HP says AI PC demand is beating expectations as the refresh fades. We should watch our own AI PC merchandising and price mix.
